mac.meaning: Device MAC address. Accepted in compact or six-pair colon/dash form, case-insensitive; the all-zero and broadcast addresses are refused.

name.meaning: Optional device label. Omission, null or an empty string uses Child device followed by the canonical MAC. The chosen label is stripped and must be nonempty, at most 80 characters and contain no characters below U+0020.

device.meaning: Registered device with its retained or initial whitelist.

mac.meaning: Device MAC in lowercase colon-separated form.

whitelist.meaning: Stored, sorted exact hostnames without a trailing dot.

registry.meaning: Path of the registry read or written by this stop.

exceptionType.meaning: Class of an unhandled exception reported by the staff front door, if any.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome token; none means the stop completed.
